taxonomy.note: Current Kew accepts the species and var. aestivalis; Texas is within the native range.

target_zone_range.evidence_basis: Williamson — dedicated county treatment documents G. aestivalis var. aestivalis. NPSOT places the species broadly in Blackland Prairie/East Central Texas systems, but broad ecoregion presence is not counted as exact county evidence.
target_zone_range.blocking_issue: Need two more exact target-zone counties.
target_zone_range.guardrail: Do not convert ecoregion-level range into county occurrence.

morphology.look_here_first: Lanceleaf blanketflower has leafy stems rather than a mostly leafless scape, hairy alternate leaves, and highly variable rays from yellow/orange-brown to partial or nearly absent; upper leaves may clasp the stem.
diagnostic_traits: rays variable in number and color
